remarks: Welcome to 42 Sturbridge Hill Road, a classic Traditional Colonial tucked on a quiet cul-de-sac road in the highly desirable Brushy Ridge neighborhood, just minutes from New Canaan's vibrant downtown shops, restaurants, and parks. This spacious home blends timeless charm with exceptional living space.  With 6 bedrooms and 5 full baths, this residence delivers both versatility and comfort. The heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen, featuring Viking stainless steel appliances and flowing seamlessly into a sunny great room graced with large windows and a charming water view - ideal for relaxed everyday living. A gracious formal dining room and an expansive living room provide beautiful settings for gatherings and special occasions.  Upstairs, discover an huge studio-style bedroom and full bath, perfectly suited as a generational living, private office or secluded retreat. The thoughtfully finished lower level adds even more living space with flexible room for a home gym, theater or playroom. Additional highlights include a large 3-car garage with dedicated work area and abundant storage throughout.  Offered "as-is," this exceptional property presents a unique opportunity to personalize and elevate to your own tastes while enjoying one of New Canaan's most desirable addresses.
